offering_description.value: TEAM provides inspection, leak detection, mechanical repair and heat treatment to industrial facility operators. It sends specialist crews and equipment to customer sites, supplies valve parts, and uses digital tools to track asset condition and document work.

quotes.quote: For over 50 years, TEAM has delivered trusted multi-service solutions that protect assets and improve performance worldwide. Our capabilities span NDT inspection, precision heat treating, and specialty mechanical services, all designed to reduce downtime, control costs, and strengthen safety. We provide advanced detection programs for leak identification, repair, and greenhouse gas control, ensuring compliance and reliability across industries. Rope access extends our inspection, maintenance, and repair solutions to challenging locations with efficiency and safety.

And because valve work rarely stands alone, we integrate every repair with TEAM360’s broader suite of services. From field machining and NDT to pressure testing, heat treatment, and OneInsight® digital reporting, TEAM delivers a connected repair strategy that works on your timeline, with fewer handoffs and greater accountability. Backed by more than 50 years of experience, we don’t just fix valves—we help you protect uptime, improve planning, and reinforce long-term performance across your entire operation.
